# ADR-3042: A04: Security control deferral for launch train 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Shipping without controls creates permanent debt.

## Decision

Teams MUST NOT accept a security control deferral for launch train 6 (A04-6) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Deferred controls get dated tickets and owners.
